response.sql: WITH matched_scans AS (SELECT scans.zoneref, scans.pressratio, sites.riskeval FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry), grouped AS (SELECT zoneref, riskeval, AVG(pressratio) as avg_pressure_ratio, COUNT(*) as scan_count FROM matched_scans GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval) SELECT zoneref, riskeval, avg_pressure_ratio, scan_count, scan_count::float / SUM(scan_count) OVER () as share FROM grouped ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
